description:
NinjaTrader 8 is running on the Windows desktop with real daily OHLCV data already imported for three instruments: SPY (S&P 500 ETF), AAPL (Apple Inc.), and MSFT (Microsoft Corp.), covering January 2023 through December 2024.

A financial services professional needs to set up a live screening tool to monitor these instruments side by side with key technical indicators.

Your task: Create a Market Analyzer window that displays all three instruments (SPY, AAPL, MSFT) with the following columns:
- Last price
- Net Change (daily price change)
- A column showing the current 14-period RSI (Relative Strength Index) value for each instrument

Once configured, save the workspace so the Market Analyzer persists across sessions.

Login credentials: Docker / GymAnything123!
